audio.text: Hello, I ordered a desk chair ten days ago, but it hasn't come.
Let me look up your order number. It's still at our warehouse. A truck was delayed because of heavy rain.
By Friday. I'll send you a tracking link today.

why.vi: Cô đặt ghế mười ngày trước nhưng chưa nhận được.
why.en: She ordered a chair ten days ago and has not received it.

questions.trap: Cô chưa nhận hàng nên chưa có hàng hỏng.

why.vi: Xe tải bị chậm vì mưa lớn, tức là thời tiết xấu.
why.en: Heavy rain is paraphrased as bad weather.

questions.trap: Địa chỉ không được nhắc là sai.

questions.q: What will the man send today?

why.vi: Anh nói sẽ gửi đường link theo dõi đơn hàng.
why.en: He says he will send a tracking link.

questions.trap: Ghế sẽ đến vào thứ Sáu, không phải hôm nay.

audio.text: I'm at your door with the boxes, but nobody is here. The label says 45 Park Street.
Oh no, we moved last month. The new address is 90 Park Street, two buildings down.
I can take them there, but you'll need to sign for them.

options: A label shows an old address

why.vi: Nhãn ghi địa chỉ cũ vì họ đã chuyển nhà.
why.en: The label has the old address because the woman moved.

questions.q: What does the man need from the woman?

why.en: She must sign for the boxes.

questions.q: What will the woman do next?

why.vi: Cô nói "I'll come outside right now".
why.en: She says she will come outside.

questions.trap: Người mang hộp đi là người đàn ông.

audio.text: How much does it cost to send this box to Singapore?
Standard shipping is twenty dollars and takes a week. Express is forty and takes two days.
The client needs the samples by Thursday. Today is Tuesday.
Then you'd better choose express. If you pay before noon, it will go out today.

questions.q: What does the woman want to do?

why.vi: Cô muốn gửi hộp đến Singapore.
why.en: She wants to send a box to Singapore.

questions.trap: Mẫu là thứ cô gửi, không phải thứ cô mua.

questions.q: Why does the woman need fast shipping?
options: The client needs the items by Thursday

why.vi: Khách cần mẫu trước thứ Năm, mà hôm nay là thứ Ba.
why.en: The client needs the samples by Thursday.

questions.trap: Cô không nói gì về cân nặng.

questions.q: What will the woman probably do?

why.vi: Chỉ có gói nhanh mới kịp, và trả trước 12 giờ sẽ gửi ngay hôm nay.
why.en: Only express meets the deadline, so she will likely pay for it.

questions.trap: Gói thường mất một tuần nên không kịp.
